rationale: Plausible but unproven: no program-specific data link senescence mechanism to the proposed orthogonal intact-EV signature or to short‑interval intranasal recoverability. Critical evidence gaps include validated low‑biomass per‑sample spike‑in recovery, orthogonal capture sensitivity in nasal/CSF/olfactory matrices, and demonstration that positive in vitro signatures predict in vivo exposure independent of route/formulation/species clearance. Resolve these analytic and translational confounders (and generate >=3 within‑donor lots per class) before adopting or prioritizing the senescence‑mechanism gate.
